in_sanskrit.name: Kitbok
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Monkey
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kitbok एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kitbok is derived from the Sanskrit words 'kit' which means 'monkey' and 'bok' which means 'little'. It is a unisex name with a meaning that conveys a playful and agile nature, suggesting a strong connection with nature and the animal kingdom.
